posthoc_deployment_evaluability.note: POST-HOC. Counts the post-dead-zone synthetic episodes that lie inside the real bf_peak_ratio IQR, i.e. the subset on which a deployment-relevant AUC could be estimated at all.

0.00.note: POST-HOC. In-sample: both thresholds (8, 0.05) were chosen on these same episodes. Compare against the CV AUC of the fitted classifiers, which are out-of-fold; the comparison is therefore biased in the shipped rule's favour and is still reported below it.
